TABLE.NAME: block_elediaai_tutor_consent
TABLE.COMMENT: Documented privacy-guidelines acknowledgements: one timestamped row per user, written the first time they confirm the privacy guidelines before using the tutor. Erased when the user account is deleted (event observer) and covered by the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the user acknowledged the privacy guidelines.

KEY.NAME: userid
KEY.COMMENT: At most one consent record per user.

TABLE.NAME: block_elediaai_tutor_diag
TABLE.COMMENT: Short admin diagnostics for failed tutor calls. Stores only non-sensitive metadata such as phase, error code and redacted detail; no prompts, answers, API keys or service tokens. Rows are pruned automatically.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user whose chat turn failed; used for privacy export/erasure.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the chat turn belonged to, or 0 for global chat.

FIELD.NAME: phase
FIELD.COMMENT: Short phase label such as configuration, mcp, rag or tool_error.

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle error code or exception class.

FIELD.NAME: detail
FIELD.COMMENT: Redacted non-sensitive debug detail for administrators.

TABLE.NAME: block_elediaai_tutor_tutor
TABLE.COMMENT: Saved site-wide tutor profiles: a named, reusable bundle of tutor settings (persona + every design token + behaviour/launcher/footer) serialised as JSON, plus optional logo/avatar images stored in the system context (file areas tutorlogo/tutoravatar, itemid = this row id). Admins create these by duplicating a built-in preset or importing a bundle; applying a profile snapshot-copies its values into the site config or a block instance.

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable machine name, unique; used in export bundles.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional admin notes describing the tutor.

FIELD.NAME: settings
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON map of registry key => value defining the tutor's persona and design.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order in the management list.
